supersedes: OCScore-M1 (366 features); smina_ad4_scoring excluded from the candidate score block, see ../ad4_audit.md
methodology: frozen Gen3B screening arm (G_bce): BCE with pairwise screening term at weight 0.1, 50/50 DUDEz and LIT-PCBA domain sampling
affinity_latent: not used; the Gen3B screening arm has no affinity pretraining stage

ensemble.rule: equal-weight mean of within-target percentile ranks

PDBbind.use: feature-selection refit and context standardisation only; no affinity pretraining in this release

holdout: none; every development family trains, because nothing is evaluated here

preprocessing.scores: negated to the literature convention, then standardised within receptor
preprocessing.context: standardised with mean and sd fitted on all eligible PDBbind rows

limitations: scores and ligand descriptors are standardised within receptor, so the model ranks a library against one target and cannot score a single compound in isolation
no demonstrated runtime saving over the full-feature model: every docking engine still runs and the descriptor routine still computes the full RDKit set
filtering is not established as an accuracy improvement, only as no detected loss

the exclusion of smina_ad4_scoring is not established as a predictive improvement: M1.1 - M1 is +0.0023 BEDROC on DUDEz and -0.0058 on LIT-PCBA, both intervals spanning zero, and -0.0001 on LIT-PCBA without the high-leverage OPRK1 family

the checkpoint retains an unused affinity branch and head, br_aff and aff, 8,721 of 308,514 parameters, left from the joint affinity-and-screening design; it is initialised but never trained or evaluated in this release

hyperparameters were chosen from 90 Optuna trials per study, selecting on held-out BEDROC; 9 of the 15 tuned values sit at or next to a search bound, depth at its maximum of 4 and steps at its maximum of 4000 among them, so the search space rather than the architecture may be what limits the configuration

the ligand-only control was tuned over a smaller space, seven parameters being fixed, so per dimension it is better searched than the structural arm; any tuning asymmetry therefore works against the structural margin rather than for it
